label: DIRTY_ENGINEERING
artifact: uniform-q4-group64-v1 used as harness only; no Q4-specific assumption shipped as a default

correctness.generated_text: Here's a simple function in Python that reverses a string
correctness.state_contract: qwen80_fixture_advance_hybrid_state multi-token reset / determinism tests passed

measurement_bugs_fixed: deltanet_conv_secs / deltanet_recurrent_secs / gqa_* were only written on the host-fallback mixer. Production uses forward_token_device, so the baseline ~0 was an unwritten timer, not a measured zero. Device path now records host encode-wall of those kernels: conv ~2 ms / 28 tokens, recurrent ~3 ms, gqa rms ~2-4 ms, rope ~1 ms. They are genuinely tiny.

deltanet_secs / gqa_secs on the device path were the entire prefix CB wall (mixer + shared MLP + router + wait), not mixer work. moe_combine_secs was the entire suffix CB (routed experts + combine + wait).

qwen_uniform_q4_group64_matvec_component_tcb still hardcodes qwen_uniform_q4_group64_matvec (serial, 1 thread/row). a47f8259 switched the expert-table kernel to simdgroup; DeltaNet/GQA/shared/router/lm_head never reach it. simdgroup is documented not bit-identical, so it was not made the component default.

classification.verdict: GPU idle because no work is ready (sync / host-bind bound). Opposite of under-occupied-kernel as the complete-token wall.

honest_family_gpu_b3_split_path_28_forwa.note: split overlap path attributes mixer / moe_prefix / suffix to separate CBs. GPU ns are GPUEndTime-GPUStartTime. Per-token = total/28.

classification.deltanet_conv_recurrent: encode-wall microseconds; not the 3.33 s bucket. The 3.33 s was mixed prefix CB wall.
classification.moe_combine_in_scope: suffix GPU is ~25 ms/token of real routed+combine work; the 1.68 s stage (60 ms/token) is ~half wait. Overlap removes that wait but did not win complete-token wall.

split_overlap.what: submit suffix and next mixer without wait; wait only on moe_prefix for router logits
split_overlap.verdict: not a robust win. B1 -34 ms, B2 +80 ms (table_build spiked), B3 -5 ms. Prefill often slower (146 CBs vs 98).

fuse.what: suffix_L + mixer_{L+1} + moe_prefix_{L+1} in one CB, 51 CBs/token
fuse.verdict: regression on the cleanest pair (F1 vs A4). Default off.

serial_encoder.what: one serial compute encoder per mixer/prefix/suffix CB
serial_encoder.verdict: not a robust complete-token win. Default off.

defaults_shipped.measurement: family GPU timestamps, device-path substage encode-wall, token_ns gpu_start/end + gap

next_bottleneck.name: host top-10 + expert address-table bind (moe_table_build_secs)
next_bottleneck.note: 48 layers × host softmax/top-10 on 512 logits + 512-entry gpuAddress rewrite. GPU is idle during this. Device-side top-k would let suffix+next prefix stay on the queue. Out of this lane if treated as MoE table work; it is the reason mixer overlap cannot fill the GPU.
